```{r setup, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
draw_label_theme <- function(label, theme = NULL, element = "text", ...) {
  if (is.null(theme)) {
    theme <- ggplot2::theme_get()
  }
  if (!element %in% names(theme)) {
    stop("Element must be a valid ggplot theme element name")
  }

  elements <- ggplot2::calc_element(element, theme)

  cowplot::draw_label(label, 
                      fontfamily = elements$family,
                      fontface = elements$face,
                      colour = elements$color,
                      size = elements$size,
                      ...
  )
}
```

# A: umap plots of re-clustered of NK cells and monocytes from CITE-seq data using WNN

```{r import re-clustered NK mono data, fig.align='center', fig.width=15.5, fig.height=4.5}
# import the re-clustered object (on which ALRA has been run)

temp<- tempfile(fileext = ".rds")
dl <- drive_download(
as_id("1hYk-5ndaUTz2aVW4vkm6sGOOvasRyKCP"), path = temp, overwrite = TRUE)
nkmono <- readRDS(file = dl$local_path)

# nkmono <- readRDS("82k_WNN reclustered exvivo NK monos with ALRA.rds") # local

# universally change cluster number to start from 1 instead of zero
Idents(nkmono) <- 'seurat_clusters'

table(Idents(nkmono)) # before changing

nkmono$seurat_clusters <- as.factor(as.numeric(as.character(nkmono$seurat_clusters)) + 1)

Idents(nkmono) <- "seurat_clusters" # reassign

table(nkmono$predicted.celltype.l2, Idents(nkmono)) # check. there are 2cells that are cDC2, remove them

nkmono <- subset(nkmono, subset= predicted.celltype.l2 != "cDC2")

```


```{r umap plots, fig.align='center', fig.width=15.5, fig.height=4.5}

# downsample

table(nkmono$phenotype)

Idents(nkmono) <- 'phenotype'
cell.list.para <- WhichCells(nkmono, idents= "Parasitemic", downsample = 1612)
cell.list.apara <- WhichCells(nkmono, idents= "Aparasitemic")

cell.list <- c(cell.list.apara, cell.list.para)

nkmono.downsampled <- nkmono[, cell.list]

Idents(nkmono.downsampled) <- 'seurat_clusters'

# create a version for final figure 5a
all.split<-SplitObject(nkmono.downsampled, split.by = "phenotype")
all_para <-all.split$Parasitemic
all_apara <-all.split$Aparasitemic


# plot all cells in a single umap showing clusters
all_umap_plot1 <- nkmono.downsampled %>%
  DimPlot(.,
          reduction = "wnn.umap", 
          group.by = "ident", 
          label = TRUE, 
          label.size = 3, 
          repel = TRUE,
          pt.size = 0.03,
          raster = FALSE,
          combine = FALSE)

all_umap_plot1 <- all_umap_plot1[[1]]$data %>%
  mutate(class = "all cells (3224 cells, n = 8)")


# plot aparasitemic clusters

clusters_apara_plot2 <- all_apara %>%
  DimPlot(.,
          reduction = "wnn.umap", 
          group.by = "ident", 
          label = TRUE, 
          label.size = 3, 
          repel = TRUE,
          pt.size = 0.03,
          raster = FALSE,
          combine = FALSE)

clusters_apara_plot2 <- clusters_apara_plot2[[1]]$data %>%
  mutate(class = "aparasitemic (1612 cells, n = 4)")

# plot parasitemic clusters 

clusters_para_plot3 <- all_para %>%
  DimPlot(.,
          reduction = "wnn.umap", 
          group.by = "ident", 
          label = TRUE, 
          label.size = 3, 
          repel = TRUE,
          pt.size = 0.03,
          raster = FALSE,
          combine = FALSE)

clusters_para_plot3 <- clusters_para_plot3[[1]]$data %>%
  mutate(class = "parasitemic (1612 cells, n = 4)")

# all cells showing cell types
all_celltype_plot4 <- nkmono.downsampled %>%
  DimPlot(.,
          reduction = "wnn.umap", 
          group.by = "predicted.celltype.l2", 
          label = TRUE, 
          label.size = 3, 
          repel = TRUE,
          pt.size = 0.03,
          raster = FALSE,
          combine = FALSE)

all_celltype_plot4 <- all_celltype_plot4[[1]]$data %>%
  mutate(class = "cell types")


# plot the first three umaps showing cluster information

all_umaps_dat_clusters_123 <- bind_rows(all_umap_plot1,
                                        clusters_apara_plot2,
                                        clusters_para_plot3) %>%
  mutate(class = factor(class, levels = c("all cells (3224 cells, n = 8)",
                                          "aparasitemic (1612 cells, n = 4)",
                                          "parasitemic (1612 cells, n = 4)"))) 

strip <- ggh4x::strip_themed(background_x = elem_list_rect(fill = c("gray80", "#58a4cb",   "#e41a1c", alpha = 0.6)))

# get colors
display.brewer.all(n=10, exact.n=FALSE) # pick a qualitative palette for cell type and use spectral for clusters

new_colors_clusters = colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(10,"Spectral"))(length(unique(all_umaps_dat_clusters_123$ident)))

find_center <- function(my_vector) my_vector[ceiling(length(my_vector)/2)]

figure_5a_clusters <- all_umaps_dat_clusters_123 %>%
    group_by(class, ident) %>%
    mutate(midval_umap1_by_celltype = find_center(wnnUMAP_1)) %>%
    mutate(midval_umap2_by_celltype = find_center(wnnUMAP_2)) %>%
    mutate(cell_label = factor(ident, levels = as.character(sort(as.numeric(unique(ident)))))) %>%
    mutate(label = ifelse(wnnUMAP_1 == midval_umap1_by_celltype & class == "all cells (3224 cells, n = 8)", cell_label, "")) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    ggplot(., aes(x = wnnUMAP_1, y = wnnUMAP_2, color = factor(ident,levels = as.character(sort(as.numeric(unique(ident))))))) +
    geom_point(size = 0.5) +
    scale_color_manual(values = new_colors_clusters) +
    geom_text(aes(label = label), color = "black", size = 4) +
    xlab("wnnUMAP 1") +
    ylab("wnnUMAP 2") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "top",
          legend.margin = margin(),
          legend.spacing.x = unit(0.05, "cm"),
          legend.spacing.y = unit(0.05, 'cm'),
          legend.key.size = unit(1, "lines"),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
          plot.margin=unit(c(0.1,0.1,0.1,0.1), "null"),
          strip.text = element_text(size = 11)) +
    facet_grid2(cols = vars(class), strip = strip) +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(title="cluster",
                                 nrow = 1,
                                 override.aes = list(size=2.5)))

figure_5a_clusters

# plot fourth umap showing cell type

new_colors_celltype = colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(10,"Paired"))(length(unique(all_celltype_plot4$predicted.celltype.l2)))
```

# B: Cell surface marker expression across NK cell and monocyte clusters

## Reassign cluster numbers, split NK and monocytes and set up markers to be included

```{r set up cluster numbers from one and select mono and NK markers}

table(nkmono$predicted.celltype.l2, nkmono$seurat_clusters)

# total number of cells are 3512. Keep only cells that are more than 5% of total (> 175 cells). This includes C1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8

Idents(nkmono) <- 'seurat_clusters'

mono <- subset(nkmono, idents = c("2","4","6","7","8"))

nkcells <- subset(nkmono, idents = c("1","3","5"))

# for description of clusters
table(mono$seurat_clusters, mono$phenotype)

# 
table(nkcells$seurat_clusters, nkcells$phenotype)
# keep only relevant markers

my_markers_mono <- c( "CD23", "CD11c", "CD38.1",
                "CD183-CXCR3", "CD196-CCR6", "CD185-CXCR5", "CD279-PD-1", "CD161", "CD16", "CD14.1", "HLA-DR", "CD69.1", "CD36.1", "CD32", "CD64")

my_markers_nkcells <- c("CD56-NCAM", "CD23", "CD11c",  "CD38.1","CD183-CXCR3", "CD196-CCR6", "CD185-CXCR5", "CD279-PD-1", "CD161", "CD16",  "HLA-DR", "CD69.1", "CD36.1", "CD32", "CD64")
```

## Create dot plots for each cell type

```{r dot plots for monocyte and Nk cell cluster cell surface marker expression,  include=TRUE}

seurat_dotplot_mono <- DotPlot(mono, features= rownames(mono[["ADT"]]), scale = T, idents = Idents(mono)) +
  coord_flip()

gg_dat_new_mono <- seurat_dotplot_mono$data %>%
  arrange(features.plot, id) %>%
  dplyr::rename(feature = features.plot) %>%
  mutate(feature_type = ifelse(feature %in% my_markers_mono, "relevant", "non-relevant")) %>%
  group_by(feature) %>%
  mutate(scale_sanity_check = scale(avg.exp)[,1]) %>% #double check to see if avg.exp.scaled was by group
  ungroup()

gg_dat_new_mono %>%
  ggplot(., aes(scale_sanity_check, avg.exp.scaled)) +
  geom_point() +
  stat_smooth(formula = y ~ x, method = "lm") +
  stat_cor() +
  theme_bw()

cellsurface_mono <- gg_dat_new_mono %>%
  mutate(cluster = id) %>%
  mutate(id = as.integer(id)) %>%                                     # make id numeric for reordering purposes
  dplyr::filter(!feature %in% c("APC-Streptavidin", "PE-Streptavidin")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(feature_type == "relevant") %>% # filter only ADT
  mutate(feature = gsub("\\..*", "", feature)) %>% #subbing out ".1"
  mutate(feature = fct_reorder2(feature, id, scale_sanity_check)) %>% # this means we want to reorder the feature by id then by expression
  ggplot(., aes(x = cluster, y = feature)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = pct.exp, colour = scale_sanity_check)) +
  scale_color_viridis_b(name = "scaled expression", labels = NULL, n.breaks = 10) + # use viridis, change legend title for expression, remove tick labels to simplify
  theme_bw() +
  ggtitle("monocytes") +
  theme(legend.position = "top", # put legends at bottom
        legend.box="horizontal",   
        axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 12, color = "black", angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
        legend.margin=margin()) + 
  labs(size ='% expression')  + #change legend title for size of bubbles
  coord_flip() +
  guides(size = guide_legend(nrow = 1, order = 1))

cellsurface_mono

# NK cells

seurat_dotplot_nkcells <- DotPlot(nkcells, features= rownames(nkcells[["ADT"]]), scale = T, idents = Idents(nkcells)) +
  coord_flip()

gg_dat_new_nkcells <- seurat_dotplot_nkcells$data %>%
  arrange(features.plot, id) %>%
  dplyr::rename(feature = features.plot) %>%
  mutate(feature_type = ifelse(feature %in% my_markers_nkcells, "relevant", "non-relevant")) %>%
  group_by(feature) %>%
  mutate(scale_sanity_check = scale(avg.exp)[,1]) %>% #double check to see if avg.exp.scaled was by group
  ungroup()

gg_dat_new_nkcells %>%
  ggplot(., aes(scale_sanity_check, avg.exp.scaled)) +
  geom_point() +
  stat_smooth(formula = y ~ x, method = "lm") +
  stat_cor() +
  theme_bw()

cellsurface_nkcells <- gg_dat_new_nkcells %>%
  mutate(cluster = id) %>%
  mutate(id = as.integer(id)) %>%                                     # make id numeric for reordering purposes
  dplyr::filter(!feature %in% c("APC-Streptavidin", "PE-Streptavidin")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(feature_type == "relevant") %>% # filter only ADT
  mutate(feature = gsub("\\..*", "", feature)) %>% #subbing out ".1"
  mutate(feature = fct_reorder2(feature, id, scale_sanity_check)) %>% # this means we want to reorder the feature by id then by expression
  ggplot(., aes(x = cluster, y = feature)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = pct.exp, colour = scale_sanity_check)) +
  scale_color_viridis_b(name = "scaled expression", labels = NULL, n.breaks = 10) + # use viridis, change legend title for expression, remove tick labels to simplify
  theme_bw() +
  ggtitle("NK cells") +
  theme(legend.position = "top", # put legends at bottom
        legend.box="horizontal",   
        axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 12, color = "black", angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
        legend.margin=margin()) + 
  labs(size ='% expression')  + #change legend title for size of bubbles
  coord_flip() +
  guides(size = guide_legend(nrow = 1, order = 1))

cellsurface_nkcells
```

# C. boxplots showing canonical NK cell marker genes

```{r boxplots with canonical NK cell marker genes, fig.align='center', fig.height=4, fig.width=2}

# make sure clusters are correctly labeled
Idents(nkmono)

# select clusters 1,3 and 5

nk.select <- subset(nkmono, idents= c("1", "3", "5"))

DefaultAssay(nk.select) <- "RNA"

seu_featplot <- VlnPlot(nk.select, c("IFNG", "TNF","GZMB", "PRF1"), log = T, layer = "scale.data")

# create new df with all expression values

extracted_dfs <- lapply(seu_featplot, function(single_plot) {
  return(single_plot@data)
})

gg_featplot_dat <- data.frame("barcode" = rownames(seu_featplot@data),
                              "cluster" = seu_featplot@data$ident, 
                              "IFNG" = seu_featplot[[1]]@data$IFNG,
                              "TNF" =seu_featplot[[2]]@data$TNF,
                              "GZMB" = seu_featplot[[3]]@data$GZMB, 
                              "PRF1" = seu_featplot[[4]]@data$PRF1) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(barcode, cluster), 
    names_to = "gene", 
    values_to = "expression") %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  mutate(pct.max.exp = expression/max(expression)) %>%
   mutate(scaled_expression = scale(expression)[,1]) %>%
     ungroup()

mycomparisons <- list(c("1", "3"), c("1", "5"), c("3", "5"))
symnum.args <- list(cutpoints = c(0, 0.0001, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 1), symbols = c("****", "***", "**", "*", "ns"))

gg_vlnplot <- ggplot(gg_featplot_dat, aes(x = cluster, y = expression, colour = cluster)) +
  ggbeeswarm::geom_quasirandom(width = 0.25, size=0.1, alpha=0.6) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.5, color = "gray20", alpha = 0, stroke=0.005) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        legend.margin = margin(),
        legend.spacing.y = unit(0.1, "cm"),
        legend.key.height = unit(0.75, "lines"),
        legend.text = element_blank(),
        plot.margin=unit(c(0.1,0.1,0.1,0.1), "null"),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 11, color = "black", face = "italic"),#,
        strip.background = element_blank()) +
  ylab("scaled expression") +
  scale_color_manual(values= c("1" = new_colors_clusters[[1]],
                               "3" = new_colors_clusters[[4]],
                               "5" = new_colors_clusters[[5]])) +
  facet_wrap(~ factor(gene, levels = c("IFNG","TNF", "GZMB", "PRF1")), ncol=1, strip.position = "right") +
   scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.2, 0.4))) +
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = mycomparisons, symnum.args = symnum.args,
                     method = "wilcox", show.legend = FALSE, size = 1.7)

gg_vlnplot

gg_vlnplot -> figure5c

```


# based on newer analysis of 82K object, extract the exact C4 and C7 population frequnencies of total monocytes and correlate

```{r} 

# from google drive

temp<- tempfile(fileext = ".csv")
dl <- drive_download(
as_id("1guhnGW0SwsHFHP8QoHRcuVIxJNx0c7X9"), path = temp, overwrite = TRUE)
monoc4_c7 <- read.table(file = dl$local_path,  sep=",", header = T)

monoc4_c7 <- read.table("~/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-IndianaUniversity/Desktop/R21 Sterile Immunity data and scripts/CD36 monocyte immunophenotyping/15 sample experiment/ex vivo/Outs from FlowJo analysis/C4 and C7 populations CITEseq.csv", sep=",", header = T) %>%
  subset(File.Name %nin% c("Mean", "Median", "Max", "SD", "CV")) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = gsub("kali0", "", File.Name)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = gsub(".fcs", "", subj_id)) %>%
  #janitor::clean_names() %>%
  rename_with(~ "C4", .cols = 2) %>%
  rename_with(~ "C7", .cols = 3) %>%
  dplyr::select(-File.Name) %>%
  mutate(C4= 100*C4) %>%
  mutate(C7= 100*C7)

cor.df <- merge(monoc4_c7, clinicaldata, .by = "subj_id")

# with time to first 
C4_tte <- cor.test(cor.df$C4, cor.df$FIRST)
C7_tte <- cor.test(cor.df$C7, cor.df$FIRST)

# with first parasite density
C4_density <- cor.test(cor.df$C4, cor.df$ParasiteDensity)
C7_density <- cor.test(cor.df$C7, cor.df$ParasiteDensity)

# on C4 pct of monocytes

r_val <- round(C4_tte$estimate, 2)
p_val <- format.pval(C4_tte$p.value, digits = 3) 
label_text <- paste0("r = ", r_val, ", p = ", p_val)

# 3. Build the scatterplot
C4_tte_plot <- ggplot(cor.df, aes(x = C4, y = FIRST)) +
  geom_point(color = "#2b5c8f", size = 2.5, alpha = 0.7) +  
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "#d95f02", fill = "#cbd5e1") + 
  annotate(
    "text", 
    x = max(cor.df$C4) * 0.6, 
    y = max(cor.df$FIRST) * 0.9, 
    label = label_text, 
    color = "black", 
    size = 5
  ) + 
  theme_bw() 


# on C7 pct of monocytes

r_val <- round(C7_tte$estimate, 2)
p_val <- format.pval(C7_tte$p.value, digits = 3) 
label_text <- paste0("r = ", r_val, ", p = ", p_val)

# 3. Build the scatterplot
C7_tte_plot <- ggplot(cor.df, aes(x = C7, y = FIRST)) +
  geom_point(color = "#2b5c8f", size = 2.5, alpha = 0.7) +  
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "#d95f02", fill = "#cbd5e1") + 
  annotate(
    "text", 
    x = max(cor.df$C4) * 0.6, 
    y = max(cor.df$FIRST) * 0.9, 
    label = label_text, 
    color = "black", 
    size = 5
  ) + 
  theme_bw() 


c4_7.tteplots <- plot_grid(C4_tte_plot, C7_tte_plot, 
                           nrow=1, 
                           labels = c( "% C4", "% C7"))

c4_7.tteplots


# On parasite density at first infection



# on C4
r_val <- round(C4_density$estimate, 2)
p_val <- format.pval(C4_density$p.value, digits = 3) 
label_text <- paste0("r = ", r_val, ", p = ", p_val)

# 3. Build the scapcrrplot
C4_density_plot <- ggplot(cor.df, aes(x = C4, y = ParasiteDensity)) +
  geom_point(color = "#2b5c8f", size = 2.5, alpha = 0.7) +  
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "#d95f02", fill = "#cbd5e1") + 
  annotate(
    "text", 
    x = max(cor.df$C4) * 0.6, 
    y = max(cor.df$ParasiteDensity) * 0.9, 
    label = label_text, 
    color = "black", 
    size = 5
  ) + 
  theme_bw() 


# on pct negative (important, since these were only seen in Malian children and not in US donors)

r_val <- round(C7_density$estimate, 2)
p_val <- format.pval(C7_density$p.value, digits = 3) 
label_text <- paste0("r = ", r_val, ", p = ", p_val)

# 3. Build the scapcrrplot
C7_density_plot <- ggplot(cor.df, aes(x = C7, y = ParasiteDensity)) +
  geom_point(color = "#2b5c8f", size = 2.5, alpha = 0.7) +  
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "#d95f02", fill = "#cbd5e1") + 
  annotate(
    "text", 
    x = max(cor.df$C4) * 0.6, 
    y = max(cor.df$ParasiteDensity) * 0.9, 
    label = label_text, 
    color = "black", 
    size = 5
  ) +

mono.densityplots <- plot_grid(C4_density_plot, C7_density_plot,
```

```{r NK cell flow data, include=TRUE}
as_id("1W7v2MOTlhumWUeLgv3u9OZGSTRImQOvL"), path = temp, overwrite = TRUE)

nkc3_c5_pct <- read.table("~/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-IndianaUniversity/Desktop/R21 Sterile Immunity data and scripts/CD36 monocyte immunophenotyping/15 sample experiment/ex vivo/Outs from FlowJo analysis/CD11c hi NK on C4 and C5.csv", sep=",", header = T) %>%
  subset(File.Name %nin% c("Mean", "Median", "Max", "SD", "CV")) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = gsub("kali0", "", File.Name)) %>%
  mutate(subj_id = gsub(".fcs", "", subj_id)) %>%
  rename_with(~ "C3_pct", .cols = 2) %>% # change cluster annotations based on 82K new data
  rename_with(~ "C5_pct", .cols = 3) %>% #change cluster annotations based on 82K new data
  mutate(C5_pct= C5_pct*100) %>% 
  mutate(C3_pct= C3_pct*100) %>%

  dplyr::select(-File.Name)
```

# examine the expression of IP-9 aparasitemic on NK and mono

# Figure 5e

```{r fig 5 d tuan, fig.align='center', fig.width=11, fig.height=3.5}

# create groups
group1 <- c("ICAM1", "ITGAM")
group2 <- c("NRG1","ERBB2")
group3 <- c("TNF", "TNFRSF1A", "TNFRSF1B")
group4 <- c("PVR", "CD226")
group5 <- c("TIMP1", "CD63")
group6 <- c("ULBP2", "KLRK1")
group7 <- c( "PPBP","CXCL1","CXCL2","CXCL3","CXCL5","CXCL8","CXCR1", "CXCR2")
group8 <- c("IL18", "IL18R1")
group9 <- c("TGFB2", "TGFBR1", "TGFBR3")
group10 <- c("BMP2", "BMP6", "BMPR1A")

# check to see if group members are unique
all(!duplicated(c(group1, group2, group3, group4, group5, group6, group7, group8)))


ip9_genes <- c(group1, group2, group3, group4, group5, group6, group7, group8, group9, group10)


ligands <- c("ICAM1", "NRG1", "TNF", "PVR", "TIMP1", "ULBP2", "PPBP", "CXCL1", "CXCL8", "CXCL2", "CXCL3", "CXCL5", "IL18", "TGFB2", "BMP2", "BMP6")

# keep aparasitemic NK and monocyte clusters

nkmono_ipclust <- subset(nkmono, idents = c("3","4","5", "7"))

nkmono_ipclust <- RenameIdents(nkmono_ipclust, "3" = "3 (NK)", "4" = "4 (mono)", "5" = "5 (NK)","7" =  "7 (mono)")

# plot as dotplot

DefaultAssay(nkmono_ipclust) <- "RNA"

seurat_dotplot_rna <- DotPlot(nkmono_ipclust, features= ip9_genes, scale = T) +
  coord_flip()

gg_dat_new_rna <- seurat_dotplot_rna$data %>%
  arrange(features.plot, id) %>%
  dplyr::rename(feature = features.plot) %>%
  group_by(feature) %>%
  mutate(scale_sanity_check = scale(avg.exp)[,1]) %>% #double check to see if avg.exp.scaled was by group
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(ip_pairmate = ifelse(feature %in% ligands, "ligand", "receptor")) 


# make new dummy variable for sorting groups based on member features (for faceting)
gg_dat_new_rna <- gg_dat_new_rna %>%
  mutate(variable_to_order_groups = case_when(
    feature %in% group1 ~ 1,
    feature %in% group2 ~ 2,
    feature %in% group3 ~ 3,
    feature %in% group4 ~ 4,
    feature %in% group5 ~ 5,
    feature %in% group6 ~ 6,
    feature %in% group7 ~ 7,
    feature %in% group8 ~ 8,
    feature %in% group9 ~ 9,
    feature %in% group10 ~ 10)) %>%
  # adding an additional group names just so that the facets have names (instead of only numbers)
  mutate(group_names = case_when(
    feature %in% group1 ~ "Group 1",
    feature %in% group2 ~ "Group 2",
    feature %in% group3 ~ "Group 3",
    feature %in% group4 ~ "Group 4",
    feature %in% group5 ~ "Group 5",
    feature %in% group6 ~ "Group 6",
    feature %in% group7 ~ "Group 7",
    feature %in% group8 ~ "Group 8",
    feature %in% group9 ~ "Group 9",
    feature %in% group10 ~ "Group 10"))

# make second new dummy variable for sorting features based on whether they are receptors or ligands, use 1 for receptor, since you want those to go first

gg_dat_new_rna <- gg_dat_new_rna %>%
  mutate(variable_to_order_features_within_group = case_when(
    ip_pairmate == "receptor" ~ 1,
    ip_pairmate == "ligand" ~ 2))

# now can plot in as faceted plot (no longer need to subset)


dotplot_5d_dat <- gg_dat_new_rna %>%
  #dplyr::filter(group_names != "Group 5") %>%
  droplevels() %>%
  mutate(feature = ifelse(ip_pairmate == "receptor", paste0(feature, "*"),  paste0(feature, ""))) %>%
  mutate(feature = fct_reorder2(feature, variable_to_order_groups, variable_to_order_features_within_group, .desc = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(variable_to_order_groups, variable_to_order_features_within_group) 

group1 <- c("ICAM1", "ITGAM")
group2 <- c("NRG1","ERBB2")
group3 <- c("TNF", "TNFRSF1A", "TNFRSF1B")
group4 <- c("PVR", "CD226")
group5 <- c("TIMP1", "CD63")
group6 <- c("ULBP2", "KLRK1")
group7 <- c( "PPBP","CXCL1","CXCL2","CXCL3","CXCL5","CXCL8","CXCR1", "CXCR2")
group8 <- c("IL18", "IL18R1")
group9 <- c("TGFB2", "TGFBR1", "TGFBR3")
group10 <- c("BMP2", "BMP6", "BMPR1A")


dotplot_5e_tuan <- dotplot_5d_dat %>%
  ggplot(., aes(y = factor(id, levels= c("4 (mono)", "7 (mono)", "3 (NK)", "5 (NK)")), x = feature)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = pct.exp, colour = scale_sanity_check), alpha=0.7) +
  #geom_point(aes(fill = ip_pairmate), alpha = 0, show.legend = TRUE) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits=rev) + # makes small cluster number at top
  scale_x_discrete(limits=rev) + 
  #scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors, name = "interaction partner", guide = "legend") +
  scale_color_viridis_b(name = "scaled expression", labels = NULL) + # use viridis, change legend title for expression, remove tick labels to simplify
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", # put legends at bottom
        legend.box="horizontal",   
        axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 14, color = "black", angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
        axis.title = element_blank(),
        legend.margin=margin()) + 
  labs(size ='% expression') + 
  xlab("cluster") + 
  #guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 0.8, shape=21), nrow = 1)) +
  facet_grid(~group_names, space = "free", scale = "free") +
  labs(caption = "receptors indicated by *") +
  theme(plot.caption.position = "plot",
        plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0.1, vjust = 21, size = 11)) 

dotplot_5e_tuan
```
